Benefits Application Rejected

U    uipathlabs@gmail.com
     To   Mihai Daniel Iorga

Retention Policy   UiPath-Email-Retention-6Y-Delete (6 years)                                      Expires   4/7/2032
ⓘ This sender uipathlabs@gmail.com is from outside your organization.

Start your reply all with:   Can you tell me why?   Thank you for letting me know   What does this mean?   ⓘ Feedback

                                                                                                      Reply     Reply All     Forward     [Teams icon]     ...
                                                                                                      Thu 4/9/2026 5:25 PM

Greetings Applicant,

We are writing to inform you that, after careful review, your application for benefits has been denied.

The reason for this decision is that your income exceeds the allowed income limit for this program.

If you believe this determination is based on incorrect information, or if your circumstances change, you may contact our office to discuss possible next steps or appeal options.

Regards,
Benefit Claims Department
